Only those that have a (+) can be upgraded.
Then he clicked on the last one.
Frost Dominion.
[Frost Dominion]
[Description: Ability to have limited control over Frost present in the environment.
At lower levels, creating ice is not possible.
Uses 0.2 mana per Minute of use.]
Lian raised his eyebrow.
Currently, his mana was very low.
But this innate skill could become something terrifying in the future.
If he got his first evolution, if the rank of this talent increased, then he might be able to create ice from nothing.
But something else occupied his mind.
Fragments.
Twenty-one.
He frowned.
"Wait..." Before entering the city, he only had one fragment.
He had gotten ten more from discovering Frostheart.
So where had the ten extra fragments come from?
There was no way he could have gotten that many fragments by killing that many monsters.
Something came to his mind.
He looked at his old title.
Wolf Slayer.
He opened its description.
[Wolf Slayer]
[You are the first person to have slaughtered a Fallen Wolf.
From now on, for every wolf you kill: +2 Fragments.]
For a moment, Lian’s eyes widened.
Then a smile appeared on his face.
"So that is the reason."
He had killed five frost wolves.
So that was why he had gotten ten fragments.
Everything fell into place.
And more importantly, outside the castle, there were more than twenty other wolves.
If he killed all of them, the amount of fragments he would get would be insane.
That way, his number of fragments would reach more than 60.
Would it not be possible to easily upgrade all his skills like that?
Then he clicked on Stats to take a look at them.
[Strength: 78]
[Spirit: 5]
[Speed: 66 ]
[Mana: 3]
[Resistance: 32]
[Stat Points: 68 ]
68 Stats Points!.
A number that surprised even himself.
He had earned 20 points from discovering the city, 28 points from killing 7 Frost Stalker monsters (each kill gave 4 points), and then another 20 from killing wolves (each again giving 4 points).
He had also realized that the system rounds the points, for example, if a monster’s stat is actually 466 percent, his talent only gives him 4 points for it.
His strength and speed were insanely high, but he also had clear weaknesses.
Mana, soul, and resistance were all low.
If he faced a creature like Mira again, these weaknesses could be deadly.
Especially for using his new innate skill and his other offensive skill, he needed mana.
Lian leaned back on the chair and stared at his stats pointes
His finger hovered over the floating window.
Now was the time to choose.
A choice that could determine the outcome of future battles.
A small smile appeared on his lips.
"The best way to use these points..."
At that moment, a heavy sound was heard from deep inside the castle.
The sound of something very large being hit.
Lian immediately stood up.
His eyes narrowed.
"Seris...?" He was sure that girl had done something again.

chapters.title: Chapter 25: The Princess’s Useful Bones
paragraphs: The sound of the castle suddenly shaking echoed through the entire royal hall. A deep roar rose from within the stones, and the frozen ceiling trembled for a moment.
Lian, who had been sitting on the chair checking his status panel, immediately raised his head.
A deep frown appeared on his face. This shaking was not normal. It was as if something deep inside the castle had been activated.
Something that should not have been activated.
The second roar was stronger than the first.
Pieces of ice broke off from the ceiling and fell to the ground. Lian stood up without delay.
"Seris..." The first thought that came to his mind was this.
A crazy girl who, even in a place like this, would probably be punching something she should not have gone near.
He closed his eyes. The sounds became clearer. The smells became sharper.
He could even feel the weak flow of energy from surrounding creatures better.
Naturally, because of the passive skill Blood Hunt, and at that moment he realized.
He could sense Seris’s familiar presence, and then he moved quickly. The frozen hallways were passed one after another.
Without wasting time, he headed toward where he felt that girl’s presence.
The further he went, the clearer the signs of shaking became. Cracks had formed on the walls.
Masses of ice had collapsed. Finally, he reached the end of one of the hallways. There, a stone staircase stood. Stairs that extended down into the underground darkness.
Lian went down the stairs without stopping. A few minutes later, he finally reached the end of the path. At that moment, he saw Seris. The young girl was standing by the wall.
Part of her clothes was torn. Burn marks could be seen on her arm. Several fresh wounds were on her body.
But fortunately, her condition did not look dangerous. When she noticed Lian’s presence, she turned her head.
"You finally came."
Lian frowned.
"What happened?"
Seris pointed with her finger toward the front.
"I think I found the castle’s treasury."
Lian followed her gaze, and a moment later he stopped. At the end of the underground hall, a massive golden door stood.

Its height was at least five meters. On its surface, thousands of complex patterns were carved. Symbols that looked like ancient magic, and even after all these years, a faint light still flowed through those lines.
Around the door, several magic circles could also be seen. This made Lian frown even more.
"A defense mechanism?"
"Yes." Seris nodded. This same defense mechanism had left her in this state.
Then, without any further explanation, she stepped forward. She stood in front of the door, clenched her fist, and delivered a heavy blow.
BOOM!
At that moment, one of the magic circles lit up. A blue light spread in the air. Suddenly, dozens of spears made of mana appeared in front.
"Watch out!" Lian’s eyes widened a little, and he warned.
But his warning was late. The spears came down like rain. Seris jumped back. She dodged several, but two spears hit her shoulder and side.
Blood sprayed on the ground. Her body was thrown back several meters.
"Damn it!" Seris landed on her feet. She wiped the blood from the corner of her mouth and stared at the door with anger.
"I don’t like this door."
Lian stepped forward and examined the mechanism for a few moments.
"It almost killed you. You should be a little more cautious." He added.
"Should we attack it together?" Seris shrugged.
Then she stepped forward again. This time, both of them attacked together. Their fists landed on the door with power.
But the result was almost zero. On the contrary, the mechanism activated again.
This time even more violently. Lightning bolts, magical blades, and small explosions of energy shot toward them.
Both were forced to retreat. But that was not enough. The spears followed them. In the end, Lian had no choice but to stop them, which was not without cost, and he received several wounds.
After a few minutes of fruitless effort, Lian finally stopped attacking.
"Wait."
"What?" Seris looked at him.
"I think I understand the problem." Lian stared at the door.
"Tell me."
"This mechanism attacks us because we are outsiders."
"So? You figured that out by yourself? That is completely obvious!" Seris frowned.
A few seconds of silence passed.
Then Lian’s eyes narrowed slightly. An idea formed in his mind. Without any explanation, he turned and moved toward the stairs.
"Where are you going?"
"An experiment."
A few minutes later, he returned. But this time, he had something in his hand. A frozen bone. The princess’s hand bone.
Seris raised an eyebrow when she saw it. She quickly understood his plan.
But she doubted that a simple bone would be enough to break the mechanism.
"Do you think it will work?"
"I don’t know." Lian stepped forward.
First step.
Nothing happened.
Second step.
Silence.
Third step. Then he hit the door hard with his fist.
But again, nothing happened. The magic circles remained off. Seris’s eyes widened.
"It worked?
"Apparently yes." Lian gave a small smile. He broke part of the bone and gave a piece to Seris.
"Hold this."
Seris took the bone. A few moments later, both approached the door without the mechanism activating.
Now the only remaining problem was the door itself. A massive lock could be seen in its center.
But there was no key. Lian examined it a little, but soon realized there was no normal way to open it.
In the end, he stepped back.
Seris stared at the door.
"Step back." She then said.
Lian glanced at her briefly, but said nothing and just stepped back a few paces.
For a few seconds, silence ruled. Seris took a deep breath. For the first time since Lian had known her, a strange aura appeared around her body.
An invisible heavy pressure spread in the air. The stones around cracked. The ice on the ground broke.
Lian’s eyes narrowed a little.
This was her power. He had never seen such a thing from Seris before. Seris pulled her fist back, and all the muscles in her body tensed.
And then she struck.
BOOOOOOM!!!
A massive explosion shook the entire underground. The walls cracked. Dust spread in the air.
And the huge golden door collapsed.
Lian’s eyes stayed open for a moment. Even he was shocked. This power was completely beyond anything Seris had shown before.
Seris shook her hand.
"Finally open."
And as if she had done something completely normal, she walked through the remains of the door.
Lian also followed her in. But the moment they entered, both stopped.
Then disbelief. And then shock. The treasury was in front of them. But unlike what they had thought, it was not very full.
But there was a large amount of gold, silver, and even mana crystals.
In a corner, several suits of armor were placed. Armor that even unfamiliar people could tell was not normal.
And a bit farther, a sword rested on a stone pedestal.
A simple sword, without special decorations. But just by looking, one could tell it was dangerous.
Very dangerous.
And next to it, a suit of armor that radiated a sense of power even from a distance.
Lian and Seris stared at the treasury in silence for a few seconds. They had finally found treasure!

chapters.title: Chapter 26: Time to Hunt
paragraphs: Both of them stared at the treasury in silence for a few seconds.
The cold air of the underground still smelled of metal, ice, and age. Treasures that had been buried under this castle for years were now in front of their eyes.
But what caught their attention more than gold and jewels were two items placed in the center of the treasury.
A sword.
And a suit of armor.
Seris walked straight toward the sword with almost no hesitation. Her footsteps echoed on the stone floor.
When she reached the stone pedestal, she reached out and took the handle of the sword.
A silver-blue blade slowly rose from the pedestal.
Lines of ice crystals ran along the blade, shining like frozen veins under the weak light of the treasury.
The handle of the sword was black, with thin silver lines carved on it.
It had no special shine. No noble decorations could be seen on it.
But just one look was enough for any fighter to understand that this weapon was not made to be beautiful.
It was made to kill.
At that moment, a window appeared in front of Seris’s eyes.
[Frostfang]
[Rank: Great (+)]
[Weapon Type: Sword]
[Effect: Slight Increase To Agility]
[Effect: Slight Increase To Ice Damage]
Seris moved the sword in the air a few times. The blade moved smoothly, like cutting through water.
It was not heavy, nor too light. As if she had used it for years. As if this sword had belonged to her from the beginning.

For the first time, a very faint smile appeared on her face. Even though the sword was not among the best, it was at least much more powerful than a normal sword and could be a great help for her in this ruined realm.
Meanwhile, Lian went toward the armor. The armor was completely different from what he expected.

It was not the massive armor of knights, nor the light leather outfit of hunters. It was something in between. Dark blue metal, compact shoulder guards, a solid chest protector, arm guards, and a design that allowed the body to move freely.
Perfect for a fighter who mostly used his fists.
When he touched it, a notification appeared.
[Frostguard Armor]
[Rank: Great]
[Effect: Increased Physical Resistance by 50+]
[Effect: Increased Cold Resistance]
Lian put it on without delay. The armor was strangely comfortable, as if it was made for his body.
When he fastened the last lock, the cold around him suddenly disappeared. Even the small amount he had been feeling was gone.
"This is good." The frown on his face relaxed a little.
"I will take the sword." Seris glanced at him.
"Then I will take the armor." Lian nodded. He could fight with his fists and did not need a weapon for now.
But he could see that without a sword, Seris lost a large part of her power. And given the threats ahead, it was better for the sword to be in that girl’s hand.
Then his gaze fell on another part of the treasury, and an even bigger smile appeared on his face.
A large number of mana crystals. At least dozens of crystals, maybe a bit more. Their blue and purple light lit up the whole treasury.
He picked up one of the crystals. Pure energy pulsed from inside it.
Mana crystals were the main currency among Awakened. Of course, they could be absorbed to increase permanent mana. Each one could increase mana by between 1 and 5 points permanently.
But for Lian, their real value was something else. Money. A very large amount of money. He did not need more stat points because he already had a lot of them.
But money? Right now, he was lacking that.
"Do you want to split them?" He looked at Seris.
"I don’t need them." The girl did not even look at them.
Lian looked at her for a few seconds, then remembered. Pendragon. One of the six founding families.
For a girl from that family, this wealth was probably nothing more than pocket money.
"Your loss." And he started collecting as much as he could.
Mana crystals, gold, silver, jewels. He took everything. The more the better. When he finished, he felt the treasury had become a little emptier.
"Do you really take everything you see?" Seris looked at him from the corner of her eye.
"It’s not called taking."
"Then what is it?"
"Resource gathering."
Seris sighed and decided not to argue. After searching for a while, they were almost sure nothing valuable remained.
"I am curious why the treasury was not completely empty. Weren’t the city’s people supposed to leave?"
"Although dozens of mana crystals are not a small amount, it is not a lot for the treasury of an entire city. Most of them were probably taken by the first groups that left the city."
"This remaining amount was probably meant to be taken by the city lord, but then that incident happened." Lian answered after thinking.
Seris showed a sign of understanding, and they were about to leave the treasury.
But just as they were leaving, Lian noticed a chest in the corner of the treasury.
A stone chest, larger than the others. He and Seris went toward it together.
They opened the lid. But inside it was empty. Completely empty.
Seris frowned.
"Why would they put an empty chest in the middle of the treasury?"
Lian said nothing. He just looked inside the chest. At the bottom, there was a strange indentation. A shape roughly like a heart.
Or maybe a crystal.
It was clear that something had been kept there for years, and later taken away.
He frowned briefly.
But he did not care about it for now. In the end, both left the treasury. When they returned to the castle’s main hall, the sky had become completely dark.
Through the frozen windows, only darkness could be seen. The wind howled outside. The sound of ice hitting could be heard from a distance.
Sometimes, the howls of ice wolves echoed through the city.
But despite all these sounds, for the first time since entering Frostheart, they felt safe.
No monster could enter this castle. At least for now, they could sleep in safety, without any problems.
Lian sat by one of the walls. Seris also leaned a little farther away.
The fatigue of the past days weighed on both of them. First they had to flee from the village, then they were caught by the monsters of this city.
For a while, silence ruled. Only the sound of the wind could be heard.
"Do you think we will succeed?" Then Seris spoke, looking at him.
Lian raised his head. For a moment, he was really surprised. This was the first time he had heard such a question from her.
Seris had always been like a sword. Cold, ruthless, and direct. But now, for the first time, she looked tired.
Lian thought for a few seconds.
"Definitely." He then said.
"How can you be sure?" Seris stared at the ceiling.
"Because we are still alive. And as long as we are alive, it means we can succeed." Lian gave a small smile.
Silence followed. But this time, the silence was not heavy. Seris closed her eyes. It was clear those words had calmed her.
It was not clear if she was asleep or just resting. A few minutes later, Lian also closed his eyes.
Time passed quietly. The wind blew. The ice moaned. Darkness ruled over Frostheart.
But in the middle of the night, Lian’s eyes suddenly opened. He had heard a sound. A weak sound. The sound of something being dragged on stone.
Scrape...
Scrape...
Scrape...
He immediately stood up. All his senses activated. He looked around. The hall was empty.
The hallways were empty. He felt no presence.
A few seconds passed, and then absolute silence returned. As if there had never been a sound.
Lian waited a few more moments, but found nothing. In the end, he slept again. He attributed the sound he had heard to his paranoia.
Though this time, his sleep was lighter than before.
The next morning.
A faint blue light entered the castle through the frozen windows. Lian slowly opened his eyes. Seris also stood up almost at the same time.
Both were ready.
New armor and a new sword. More power and a clearer goal than before.
They went to the window. But when they looked outside...
Both stopped. Frowns appeared on their faces. The city streets were filled.
Dozens of monsters. Maybe hundreds. Ice creatures moved through the alleys.
They could be seen on the rooftops. They wandered through the frozen squares. As if all of Frostheart had become aware of the two.
But these monsters did not dare to enter the castle grounds where the wolves were.
Lian stared at the scene for a few seconds. Then he gave a bitter smile.
"Well..."
Seris placed the Frostfang sword on her shoulder. Her cold eyes were fixed on the city.
"Time to hunt."

When they returned to the castle’s main hall, the sky had become completely dark.
Through the frozen windows, only darkness could be seen.
The wind howled outside.
The sound of ice hitting could be heard from a distance.
Sometimes, the howls of ice wolves echoed through the city.
But despite all these sounds, for the first time since entering Frostheart, they felt safe.
No monster could enter this castle.
At least for now, they could sleep in safety, without any problems.
Lian sat by one of the walls.
Seris also leaned a little farther away.
The fatigue of the past days weighed on both of them.
First they had to flee from the village, then they were caught by the monsters of this city.
For a while, silence ruled.
Only the sound of the wind could be heard.
"Do you think we will succeed?" Then Seris spoke, looking at him.
Lian raised his head.
For a moment, he was really surprised.
This was the first time he had heard such a question from her.
Seris had always been like a sword.
Cold, ruthless, and direct.
But now, for the first time, she looked tired.
Lian thought for a few seconds.
"Definitely." He then said.
"How can you be sure?" Seris stared at the ceiling.
"Because we are still alive.
And as long as we are alive, it means we can succeed." Lian gave a small smile.
Silence followed.
But this time, the silence was not heavy.
Seris closed her eyes.
It was clear those words had calmed her.
It was not clear if she was asleep or just resting.
A few minutes later, Lian also closed his eyes.
Time passed quietly.
The wind blew.
The ice moaned.
Darkness ruled over Frostheart.
But in the middle of the night, Lian’s eyes suddenly opened.
He had heard a sound.
A weak sound.
The sound of something being dragged on stone.
Scrape...
Scrape...
Scrape...
He immediately stood up.
All his senses activated.
He looked around.
The hall was empty.
The hallways were empty.
He felt no presence.
A few seconds passed, and then absolute silence returned.
As if there had never been a sound.
Lian waited a few more moments, but found nothing.
In the end, he slept again.
He attributed the sound he had heard to his paranoia.
Though this time, his sleep was lighter than before.
The next morning.
A faint blue light entered the castle through the frozen windows.
Lian slowly opened his eyes.
Seris also stood up almost at the same time.
Both were ready.
New armor and a new sword.
More power and a clearer goal than before.
They went to the window.
But when they looked outside...
Both stopped.
Frowns appeared on their faces.
The city streets were filled.
Dozens of monsters.
Maybe hundreds.
Ice creatures moved through the alleys.
They could be seen on the rooftops.
They wandered through the frozen squares.
As if all of Frostheart had become aware of the two.
But these monsters did not dare to enter the castle grounds where the wolves were.
Lian stared at the scene for a few seconds.
Then he gave a bitter smile.
"Well..."
Seris placed the Frostfang sword on her shoulder.
Her cold eyes were fixed on the city.
"Time to hunt."

chapters.title: Chapter 27: The Alpha Wolf
paragraphs: The frozen air of Frostheart pierced the skin like thousands of invisible needles. The massive castle gate slowly opened, and its heavy sound echoed throughout the area.
Outside...
More than twenty frost wolves were waiting. Their blue eyes shone in the snow, and cold steam came out of their mouths.
In the center of the pack, the alpha wolf stood. Bigger, scarier, and more dangerous than the rest. But for now, Lian’s gaze was on his status panel.
[Stat Points: 68]
He thought for a moment.
Then he made his decision.
[Strength: 78 --> 100]
He felt his muscles tighten, as if new force was flowing through his entire body.
But he did not stop. Then he spent 15 points to increase his resistance. He did not use more because the armor itself already increased his resistance enough.
[Resistance: 30 --> 45]
And finally, the remaining 31 points went to mana.
Suddenly, he felt the surroundings differently. As if for the first time, he could feel the presence of mana in the air. Invisible particles of energy were floating around him.
It was a strange feeling, but he had no chance to examine it.
"Can you handle half of them?"
"Of course. Faster than you." Seris drew the Frostfang sword from its sheath.
"I don’t think you can kill half of them faster than me." Lian chuckled. A moment later, both moved at the same time.
Explosion of snow, cracking of ice, and the beginning of a slaughter.
The first wolf jumped toward Lian. Its massive claws went straight for his neck. But Lian was faster.
His skill activated.
[Frost Claw Activated]
[Consumes 0.1 mana per moment]
Ice gathered on his fingers. Long, blue nails emerged from his hands.
And feeling that this might not be enough for these monsters, he used his other new innate skill to strengthen this skill.
Of course, his talent itself also made any frost-related skill automatically stronger.
[Ice Dominion]
In one motion, his hand passed by the wolf’s neck. The monster’s head spun in the air, and its body fell to the ground.
[Frostfang Wolf Level 12 Killed]
[Fragment +2]
Lian’s eyes lit up. He had intentionally looked at the notifications to check if the title worked. And the title was indeed working.
The second and third wolves attacked almost at the same time. But Lian went straight between them.
His ice claws acted like real blades. One hit, and the second wolf’s stomach was torn open.
The next hit tore open the third wolf’s chest.
Hot blood sprayed on the white snow.
[Frostfang Wolf Level 12 Killed]
[Fragment +2]
[4 stat points gained]
[Frostfang Wolf Level 12 Killed]
[Fragment +2]
[4 stat points gained]
On the other side of the field, Seris was no less than a monster. The Frostfang sword danced in her hands.
Each hit equaled one death.
Each movement, a body cut in half. The wolves could not even get close to her.
In less than a few minutes, four corpses, six corpses, eight corpses lay on the ground.
Meanwhile, three more wolves attacked Lian. He did not dodge. He went straight toward them. The ice claws hit flesh and bone.
The sound of bones crushing echoed in the air.
[Frostfang Wolf Level 13 Killed]
[Fragment +2]
[4 stat points gained]
[Frostfang Wolf Level 12 Killed]
[Fragment +2]
[4 stat points gained]
[Frostfang Wolf Level 12 Killed]
[Fragment +2]
[4 stat points gained]
Blood and pieces of flesh fell on the snow one after another. The battlefield had become an icy hell.
But the more he fought, the more Lian realized that these wolves were no longer a real threat.
He had become much stronger. Much faster. Much more dangerous.
Another wolf attacked from behind. Lian turned and thrust Frost Claw forward. The ice claws went through the monster’s chest.
[Frostfang Wolf Level 12 Killed]
[Fragment +2]
[4 stat points gained]
A few minutes later, the last wolf in front of him also fell on the snow.
[Frostfang Wolf Level 14 Killed]
[Fragment +2]
[5 stat points gained]
Lian took a deep breath. Ten wolves had been killed.
At that moment, the sound of the last monster falling came from the other side of the field. Seris shook her sword.
Blood fell from the blade. She had also killed exactly ten wolves. Now only one creature remained.
The alpha wolf.
A heavy silence took over the field. The wind howled through the ice buildings. The level fifteen monster slowly raised its head.
[Frostfang Alpha]
[Level: 15]
Its bright blue eyes locked onto Lian. Lian smiled.
"Finally." In an explosion of speed, he charged forward. The ground under his feet cracked. In the blink of an eye, he appeared in front of the alpha.
Frost Claw went toward the monster’s neck.
This time, the attack hit. Icy blood sprayed in the air. The massive wolf was pushed back several meters.
Its claws dragged on the ground. Even Seris stopped for a moment.
A level fifteen creature had been pushed back by Lian’s hit.
But suddenly, all the wolf’s fur started to shine. Blue lightning appeared across its body.
The crackling sound of electricity echoed in the air. Lian frowned. A strong sense of danger! More than anything he had felt from the wolves until that moment.
"Damn it..."
The alpha wolf raised its head. All the lightning gathered toward its mouth. And then an explosion!
A column of electricity swept through the entire ice street. There was no chance to escape.
The hit struck Lian directly. The Frostguard armor shook, and several parts cracked. Blood sprayed from Lian’s mouth. His body shot back like a bullet.
Ten meters.
Twenty meters.
Thirty meters.
He went through the wall of one ice building, then hit a second building, and finally stopped in a pile of ice and stone.
His whole body was burning. All his bones hurt. For a few seconds, even breathing was hard.
But he was still alive. He slowly stood up from the rubble, wiped the blood from the corner of his mouth, and fixed his gaze on the alpha wolf.
The monster was also staring at him. Lightning was gathering around its body again.
At that moment, Seris placed the Frostfang sword on her shoulder. Her gaze locked onto the massive monster.
"Finally, something worth killing." She said, with excitement shining in her eyes.

chapters.title: Chapter 28: The Titan Awakens
paragraphs: The corpses of the Frostfang Wolves were scattered everywhere. Some of their bodies were split in half.
Some had no heads. Some had been slammed into the ice walls so hard that only a pile of flesh and bones remained.
Lian’s breaths had become heavy. His whole body hurt, but his eyes were still fixed on the last enemy on the field.
Only one monster remained.
The pack leader.
A creature that even the other ice wolves kept their distance from. The snow under its massive claws melted and then froze again.
Its bright blue eyes were staring directly at the two. The system notification still floated in front of Lian’s eyes.
[Frostfang Alpha Wolf]
[Level: 15]
[Rank: Normal]
A deep roar came from the monster’s throat. A roar that made the surrounding streets shake.
They were not facing a normal monster like the other wolves. They were facing a real monster!
In fact, the fact that the two of them, especially Lian with his lower level, could defeat level 12 or level 13 wolves was a miracle by itself.
He did not know about Seris, but if he himself did not have his two current talents, Dormant Monster and Winter Child, he probably could not have won against those ten wolves so easily.
Winter Child weakened the attacks of ice monsters, and the Dormant Monster talent reduced the power of all monster attacks by ten percent.
The innate skill Winter Skin also weakened any attack made by frost monsters.
In addition, the Frost Claw skill, which was greatly strengthened by mana and Ice Dominion, had also helped significantly.
Otherwise, how could defeating level 12 and 13 monsters be so easy?
Lian slowly raised the ice claws of Frost Claw. On the other side, Seris drew her new sword from its sheath.
The Frostfang blade shone blue under the dim light of the sky.
A few seconds of silence ruled. They looked at each other. Through their eyes, they understood each other’s intention.
Then both moved at the same time.
BOOM!
The ground under their feet exploded. Lian attacked from the left, and Seris from the front. The alpha wolf roared and jumped forward with unbelievable speed.
The first collision caused the air to explode. Seris’s sword landed on the wolf’s massive claw.
Blue sparks spread in the air.
At the same time, Lian came in from the side and dragged Frost Claw across the monster’s stomach.
A deep scratch was made on its body. Blue blood sprayed on the snow. The wolf howled in pain, but it did not fall.
On the contrary.
Suddenly, all the fur on its body began to shine. The crackling sound of electricity echoed in the air.
Seris’s eyes narrowed.
"Back!
But it was too late. The monster’s roar reached the sky, and then the lightning exploded.
BOOM!
A column of blue electricity came out of the wolf’s body. Lian only had time to put his hands in front of his face. A second later, he felt like a mountain had hit him.
His body was thrown dozens of meters through the air. The Frostguard Armor cracked, and blood sprayed from his mouth.
BOOM!
His body hit the wall of an ice building. The whole building shook. On the other side of the field, Seris’s situation was not better.
She had put her sword in front of her body, but the wave of electricity still pushed her back several meters.
The snow under her feet was plowed. For a few seconds, no one moved. The alpha wolf was breathing heavily, and many wounds could be seen on its body.
But it was still standing. Lian came out of the rubble. His body was burning.
But a small smile appeared on his face.
"Damn it..."
"It is tougher than I thought."
Seris also stood up.
Her cold eyes stayed fixed on the monster.
"Its power is not the problem. That lightning skill of its is what causes trouble."
Lian nodded. In hand-to-hand combat, that monster had no chance. But every time it released the lightning, everything changed.

This is where the difference between monsters that have skills and monsters that do not becomes clear. And this made him understand how dangerous and powerful monsters that have gone through their first evolution are.
The wolf started gathering electricity again. Thousands of blue sparks formed around its body.
But this time, Seris suddenly lowered her sword. Her silver eyes shone.
The air became heavy.
The wind stopped. Even the sound of the blizzard disappeared for a moment.
[King’s Dominion]
[Rank: Great]
[Description: Releases the aura of a king’s dominion. All enemies within range are suppressed, and all their stats are decreased.]
An invisible pressure spread throughout the field. The ground shook. The snow settled. The alpha wolf’s eyes suddenly widened.
For the first time, fear appeared in its gaze. Its roar became weaker. The electricity around its body became unstable.
As if something was squeezing its throat.
Seris took one step forward.
"Kneel."
BOOM!
All the pressure of the aura landed on the monster’s body. The wolf’s massive legs trembled, and one of its knees hit the ground.
Lian immediately noticed the opportunity. His eyes lit up.
That was it. Just this one moment was needed. He transferred all his mana to Frost Claw and used his new skill for the second time.
[Ice Dominion]
And by controlling the ice element, the ice claws became larger and more powerful.
Ice crystals formed around his hands. Even the ice on the ground was pulled toward him.
The air froze from the cold.
BOOM!
Lian shot forward like a bullet. The distance between them disappeared in an instant. The wolf had just raised its head when the ice claw passed through its throat.
Silence.
Time seemed to stop.
Then, blue blood sprayed into the air. The monster’s massive head was severed. Its five-meter body stayed motionless for a moment.
And then...
BOOM!
The huge carcass fell to the ground. The entire street shook. For a few seconds, no sound was heard. Only the heavy breaths of Lian and Seris remained.
And then the system notifications appeared.
[Frostfang Alpha Level 15 Killed]
[Fragment +2]
[Skill gained]
Lian’s eyes lit up. But before he could read the last notification, a sound echoed throughout the city.
CRAAAAAACK...
The sound of ice breaking. A massive sound. So massive that it seemed like all of Frostheart was cracking.
The smile on Lian’s face disappeared. He and Seris simultaneously turned their heads toward the center of the city.
Where that massive ice giant had been sleeping. The sound of ice breaking was heard again.
CRAAAAAACK...
This time louder, heavier, more terrifying. And then, in the middle of the white blizzard... two blue dots lit up.
Two eyes. Massive eyes. Eyes that were slowly opening.
For the first time, Seris frowned deeply. Lian also involuntarily held his breath.
The thing that had destroyed all of Frostheart was waking up.

chapters.title: Chapter 29: The Frostfallen Titan
paragraphs: A heavy and unnatural silence had taken over the fallen city of Frostheart.
The massive corpse of the alpha wolf lay on the frozen snow, and its blue blood slowly spread on the ground.
But what had caught Lian’s attention was not the wolf’s body, but the presences that were disappearing.
With the help of the Blood Hunt skill, his senses had become unnaturally strong, and now he could feel the presence of living creatures around him.
And now all those presences were moving away.
Fast. Very fast, in fact. As if something had terrified them.
Lian frowned. Next to him, Seris also raised her head.
"They are leaving."
"Yes."
"But they are not running from us."
Lian did not answer, because he had understood the same thing. They were running from something else.
Something that had just woken up. And if his guess was correct, and he was sure it was correct, that monster was the Titan. The monster responsible for the destruction of this city.
A level 19 Fallen monster! In this situation, they had no chance against that monster.
He had killed seven level 12 wolves, two level 13 wolves, and one level 14 wolf. And above that, with Seris’s help, he had killed the alpha wolf.
He had gained 4 stat points for level 12 and 13 monsters, and 5 stat points for level 14 and 15 monsters.
Everything matched his calculations. Finally, his eyes fell on the status panel.
[Available Stat Points: 46]
His eyes lit up. He had 46 stat points. For other Awakened below level 10, this amount is insane. But not for him.
Without any hesitation, he made his decision. 20 points on strength, 10 points on resistance, and 16 points on mana.

[Resistance: 45 --> 55]
Immediately, a wave of energy spread through his entire body.
His muscles tightened. His bones made sounds. His veins became prominent.
He felt that if he punched the castle wall, he would bring part of it down. Of course, he was not sure he could actually do that.
But he could feel the flow of power in his body. Then he looked at his level bar and saw that it was almost full, and he was not far from level 9.
Then he looked at his new skill.
[Thunder Fang]
[Rank: Common (+)]
[Description: The user can use the lightning element for small explosive sparks. Consumes 0.1 mana per minute.]
"An extremely useful offensive skill," he whispered to himself. It was a useful skill, but it was not at the level the alpha wolf had used.

Not at all.

BOOM!
The sound of ice breaking echoed throughout the city. Then again.
BOOM!
The surrounding ice towers began to shake. Huge pieces of ice fell from the buildings.

"It woke up."
Lian looked toward the center of the city, and his heart stopped beating for a moment.
That ice giant was moving.
First, its fingers twitched.
The sound of ice that had sat on its body for years breaking echoed in the air. Then its massive arms moved.
Then its shoulders. And finally its head.
Slowly, very slowly, as if a mountain was waking up. Each of its movements made the ground shake. The surrounding buildings collapsed.
The ice streets cracked. The blizzard became more intense. Next to that creature...
Even multi-story buildings looked small.
A system notification appeared.
[Frostfallen Titan]
[Rank: Fallen]
[Level: ???]

The monster opened its massive blue eyes. Two icy suns. And it looked directly at them.

Lian noticed. He almost no longer felt the cold, but Seris was different.
"Are you okay?"
"For now." But her tone said something else.
Seris was the first to move. She did not want to wait to be attacked. An invisible aura spread around her body.
The surrounding snow trembled, and a heavy pressure filled the environment.
[King’s Dominion]
The skill that weakened enemies.
But...
[Effect Reduced]
[Target Rank Too High]
For the first time, Seris frowned deeply.
"Damn it." Almost no effect. The skill that had helped them defeat the alpha wolf now had practically no effect on this Titan.
But Lian did not stop. Blue sparks of electricity appeared around his body.
[Thunder Fang Activated]
The wind around him exploded.
Then...
[Fallen Wolf Speed Activated]
The world around him slowed down.
Then...
[Frost Claw]
He activated it as well, and massive ice claws formed around his hands. He released all his power. This was not a place to hold back or hide his power.
Here, he had to fight with everything he had!
And he charged forward.
BOOM!
The snow under his feet exploded. He covered several streets in an instant, reaching a speed where even seeing his movement was difficult.
And then he reached the Titan’s knee. He brought down his ice claws with all his power, and at the same time, lightning sparks gathered in his fists.
CRAAASH!
The sound of metal against metal. Ice sparks echoed. And then an explosion!
But when Lian looked at the result, only a small scratch could be seen.
One scratch. On a creature that was dozens of meters tall!
And at that moment, his heart sank. Their power was not enough. With such a hit, he could not even land a proper blow!
The Titan did not even look at him. It just raised its hand. A simple movement, completely simple. But suddenly, everything around exploded.
A massive wave of ice was released.
"Damn it! Seris, fall back!" Lian only had time to shout and warn Seris, who was coming to help him.
And then...
Explosion.
BOOOOOOM!
The world turned white for him. His body lost control. He was thrown hundreds of meters through the air, hit the wall of an ice building.
And the wall collapsed. Blood sprayed from his mouth. His ribs hurt.
His hand was numb. For the first time since escaping from that damned village, he felt the danger of death again!
Seris’s situation was not better. She had also been thrown back dozens of meters. Her clothes were torn, and parts of her beautiful body, especially her curves, were exposed.
Blood was flowing from the corner of her lips, but she still managed to stand up and was still looking at the monster.
The Titan took one step forward. Just one step, but the ground collapsed. The ice towers cracked.
And at that moment, something caught Lian’s attention.
The center of the monster’s chest. Among the massive layers of ice, a blue crystal could be seen.
A crystal that, unlike the rest of the creature’s body, was shining.
And more importantly, it was cracked. As if something was beating inside it, like a heart.
Lian’s eyes narrowed. Seris had also seen it.
"That..." Lian whispered quietly.
"Its heart?"
Seris did not answer, but her gaze would not leave that crystal.
At that moment, the Titan pulled its head back.
And it roared. A roar that shook all of Frostheart. The towers cracked. The ice windows shattered.
And the monster’s voice echoed through the entire city.
"If that is its heart..." Seris clenched her fist and said.
"Then we have to get to it." And Lian completed the sentence.
But at that very moment, the Titan took its second step.
The ground under their feet split open, and the massive shadow of the monster fell over both of them.
The real battle had just begun.

chapters.title: Chapter 30: Surviving the Cataclysm
paragraphs: The roar of the ice Titan echoed through the city like thunder.
The ice towers shook, the frozen windows cracked, and massive piles of snow fell from the roofs of buildings.
Lian wiped the blood from his lip and took his gaze off the system notifications. In front of them, that giant monster stood.
A creature that, even after waking up, looked more like a natural disaster than a monster.
Seris gripped the Frostfang sword tighter. The wind blew through her silver hair.
"Are you ready?"
Lian gave a dry smile.
"No."
"Good." Seris nodded.
"Why?"
"Because I am not ready either."
Lian did not know whether to laugh or cry, but he had no time for either. At that moment, the Titan moved.
The ground exploded. The distance of several dozen meters between them disappeared in less than a second.
"Damn it!"
Lian shouted. The Titan’s massive fist came down.
BOOM!
An explosion of snow and ice covered everything. Lian and Seris jumped back in two different directions. But even the shockwave dragged them several meters across the ground.
If that attack had hit directly, it would have been certain death.
This fight was not equal in any way. The monster they were facing was on a completely different level. But that did not mean they were completely defenseless and powerless.
Seris was the first to counterattack. Her sword flashed in the air.
[Moonstep]
WOOSH!
Her body vanished, and a moment later she appeared on the Titan’s shoulder. Her sword came down with all its power.
CRACK!
For the first time, a piece of the Titan’s natural ice armor, its skin, broke. A crack appeared.
But that was all. The wound was not even the size of a real scratch. The Titan did not even turn its head.
Then it raised its hand and pushed Seris aside like an annoying insect. For the monster, it was just a normal push. But...
BOOM!
Seris hit the wall of an ice building directly. The building collapsed. Blood flowed from the corner of her mouth, and she coughed up some blood.
Lian frowned.
"What the hell is this thing really?" He knew the fight would be hard, but not this hard. This looked less like a fight and more like a monster playing with its prey.
[Frost Claw Activated]
Ice claws formed around his hands. With the help of [Ice Dominion], he increased their power a little, and then with the intervention of his talent, their power increased a little more.
WOOSH!
He charged forward at full speed. His 120 points of strength exploded in his muscles. His claws hit the Titan’s knee directly.
CRACK!
This time a deeper crack was made. But the Titan just looked at him, then snorted and sneered. For the first time, and that sneer was scarier than any roar.
[Frozen Dominion]
The Titan raised its hand to the sky. Suddenly, the temperature of the environment dropped.
The ground froze. The buildings became covered with new crystals. Even breathing became hard.
Seris, who had no ice resistance, immediately shivered. Her lips turned blue. Her movements became slower. She felt like she was freezing from the inside.
"Damn..."
But that was only the beginning. The Titan stomped its foot on the ground.
[Glacier Break]
BOOOOM! Hundreds of ice pillars shot up from the ground. Lian barely dodged.

One pillar pierced his shoulder, and blood sprayed. Another tore open Seris’s side. Both were thrown back at the same time. However, because of the terrible cold, Seris’s muscles responded late to her brain, and an ice pillar tore through her shoulder and side on the spot.
Seeing this scene, Lian moved with explosive speed, pulled her back, and laid her on the ground.
"Are you okay?" He looked at the girl with worry. Her body was so cold that it seemed like she might freeze at any moment.
"N... no... no." Even Seris’s lips could barely move, and she could not pronounce the words properly.
Lian fell to his knees. His breaths had become heavy. Blood was flowing from several different wounds. But the worst part was that his defense was not enough.
He was not in good shape either. Seeing this girl in this state made him feel bad. If something happened to Seris, he alone could not help her.
But the problem was that even if he wanted to, he could not help her.
Every direct hit meant death for both of them. And his armor was not helping there either.
"I have no choice..." If his current skills were not powerful enough, then the only thing he needed to do was upgrade them.
A system notification appeared.
[Iron Hide]
[Rank: Common]
He pressed the upgrade option without hesitation.
[3 Fragments Consumed]
[Skill Evolved]
[Iron Hide → Steelhide]
[Rank: Great]
[Description: The user’s skin, muscles, and bones are temporarily strengthened, becoming hard and tough like steel. You gain complete immunity against heat and cold.
When activated, Resistance increases by 50 points, and the severity of damage received is reduced by 10 percent. Mana consumption: 0.3 per minute.]
Lian’s eyes lit up, and he immediately activated the skill.
[Steelhide Activated]

All the muscles in his body tightened. Metallic veins appeared under his skin. He felt his body become several times stronger. And more importantly, his resistance and defensive power increased by 50 points.
Now his resistance was 105 points!
But it was not enough.
He opened the panel again.
[Frost Claw]
[Rank: Common]
[5 Fragments Required for upgrade]
[Confirm?]
"Confirm."
[Skill Evolved]
[Frost Claw → Glacial Reaper Claw]
[Rank: Great]

[Description: The penetration power of the claws increases by 50 points. Every ten hits, a critical attack is created, dealing severe damage. The claws’ ability to cut through armor, steel, and flesh increases significantly. Penetration power against frost monsters increases by 70 points.]
[Mana consumption: 0.4 per minute.]
Lian’s hands changed. The claws became larger, longer, and the ice around them looked brighter and much sharper. Now instead of just his fingers, his whole hand had changed.

On the other side of the battlefield, Seris had also opened her panel. Notifications appeared one after another. Her skills were being upgraded. She had also come to the conclusion that it was time to make changes.
But Lian had no chance to look, because the Titan was not happy that they were wasting time. It attacked them directly.
[Frozen Cataclysm]
The Titan’s eyes shone, and suddenly a massive beam of ice energy was fired. Everything in its path froze.
Buildings, streets, even the air itself.
Lian shouted.
"Seris!" Both jumped to different sides. The beam passed through the city, and in the distance, it turned an entire tower into ice dust.
For a few seconds, silence fell. Then Lian struggled to get up from the rubble. Blood was flowing from his forehead. His ribs were broken.

His left arm was almost numb. On the other side of the field, Seris was not in better shape. Her clothes were even more torn, and more of her body was exposed, to the point that part of her chest could be seen, and her attractive curves were more visible.
Her shoulder was hanging, and blood dripped on the snow.
But both were still alive. Both were still standing.
And for the first time, the Titan’s eyes became a little serious. As if it had not expected them to survive this attack.
Of course, if Lian had not upgraded Iron Hide in time and activated it, he would be dead by now.

chapters.title: Chapter 32: Nightmare of Monsters
paragraphs: A cold wind blew through the frozen streets of Frostheart, but this time no howls could be heard.
No roars, no screams, no sound of battle. The only thing left was silence. A heavy silence that had fallen over the city.
The massive corpse of the ice Titan lay in the center of the square. A monster that was once considered the king of this city.
A monster that thousands of creatures feared, but now it lay motionless on the ground.
Lian was lying on the ground. His whole body hurt, but it did not matter. For the first time in a long time, he was alive.
Next to him, Seris sat on a piece of ice. She placed her sword beside her and stared at the Titan’s corpse for a few minutes.
Neither of them said anything.
After a battle that had nearly taken their lives, even speaking seemed hard.
Suddenly, several notifications appeared in front of Lian’s eyes.
[Level Up]
[Level 8 → Level 9]
[Level Up]
[Level 9 → Level 10]
At that moment, a warm wave spread through his whole body. Flesh, bones, veins, and his entire body began to rebuild.
The hands that had been almost destroyed in the final attack reformed. The broken bones healed. The torn skin closed.
A few seconds later, no trace of those terrible injuries remained.
Lian’s eyes widened a little. It was not the first time he had leveled up, but every time he saw something like this, it was strange.
No matter how bad his condition was, no matter if he was between life and death, as long as he leveled up, all wounds would heal.
Next to him, Seris was also covered in a white light. Her wounds closed one after another. The paleness of her face returned.
Even the hole the Titan had nearly made in her body disappeared.
A few minutes later, both were in almost the best possible condition.
Lian sighed, then stood up. His gaze fell on the monster’s massive corpse.
A small smile appeared on his face.
"We really killed it."
"Yes. This was the hardest fight I have ever had." Seris looked at the carcass, then slowly nodded.
"Me too. Until a week ago, I never thought I would be in such a fight at all." Lian laughed quietly. He had always wanted to become an Awakened.
And looking at this situation, being an Awakened did not seem that fun. But the interesting thing was that he had killed a Fallen monster!
True, he had done it with Seris’s help and not alone, but that by itself was an incredible achievement.
Monster ranks are divided into five categories: Normal, Fallen, Unholy, Demon, and Supreme. And he had managed to defeat a Fallen one.
And not like before, a level 10 Fallen that was near death, but one that was at its strongest state.

And he had done it when he was only level 8. Normally, to hunt a level 19 Fallen monster, you need at least a group of ten Awakened between level 18 and level 20, and even then, they need items, weapons, and the best armor.
If guilds, organizations, or even governments found out he had done such a feat, they would try to hire him like crazy.
For a moment, silence fell between them. Then Lian opened his notifications. The first thing that caught his attention was the Fragments.
[Fragments: 36]
Their number did not surprise him. Before using them, his Fragments had reached 41. He had used 15 of them, so they should have gone down to 26.
But from killing that Fallen monster, he had gotten 10 Fragments.
Then his gaze fell on a new skill.
[Skill Acquired]
[Frozen Cataclysm]
[Rank: Common (+)]

[Description: The user concentrates a massive amount of ice energy at one point. When released, a destructive wave of ice and cold destroys a wide area. Enemies caught in the center of the explosion receive very severe damage. Mana consumption is very high.
Consumes 30 mana per use.]
Lian whistled quietly. Even from the description, it was clear he could not fully use this skill right now. 30 mana is no small amount.
Luckily, he had leveled up twice and his mana pool was full again. Otherwise, in a normal situation, it would take hours to refill.
Then his gaze fell on the Stat Points.
[Stat Points: 27]
Lian frowned.
"Only 7?" Then he thought for a moment. He had gotten a total of 7 from killing this monster. He had expected more.
But he immediately understood the reason. Group kill. Both he and Seris had contributed to killing the Titan.
That was why the reward was split. Exactly the same thing that had happened with the Fallen Wolf in the valley.
If he had killed this monster alone, he would probably have received much more reward.
His gaze fell on another notification.
[Kill Contribution: Shared]
"So that’s why." He thought out loud.
"What?" Next to him, Seris looked at him.
"Nothing. I just realized how stingy The Will is." Lian shrugged and said.
For the first time, a small smile appeared on Seris’s lips. As if she understood what he meant. But it was very short. So short that if Lian had not been paying attention, he would have missed it.
But that itself was strange.
"Anyway, I think you should change your armor." Lian then said to her, because many parts of the girl’s body were exposed.
"Oh." Seris looked at her armor and realized it was largely destroyed.
"Please look the other way." She then said to him.
Lian nodded and took his gaze off her, looking around. The monsters of the city were still there, but none came close.
In the distant streets, on the rooftops, and in the dark corners of the city, hundreds of pairs of blue eyes could be seen. But no one dared to come near.
The monsters just watched. Nothing remained of their king but a corpse, and now they were afraid. Of course, that was normal.
But he had no plan to leave them alone.
"I changed." Then Seris said, and Lian turned and looked at her. She was wearing exactly another set of armor like the one he had.
"How many sets of that armor do you have?"
"Three. This is the second.
"I think it’s time." Lian nodded to show he understood, then added.
"Time for what?" Seris raised an eyebrow.
"Cleaning up."
A few seconds of silence passed. Then Seris picked up her sword. It was clear she understood what he meant.
"Finally, you said something I like."
A moment later, both disappeared. BOOM! The snow under their feet exploded. Their speed was so high that they only left a faint trace behind.
The first monster did not even have time to run. Lian’s claw tore its throat.
[Frosthorn Stalker Level 7 Killed]
Blood sprayed on the snow.
The second monster was cut in half by Seris’s sword.
Third.
Fourth.
Fifth.
The slaughter had begun. But this time, the roles of hunter and prey had switched. The monsters were running, and the two were chasing them.
As time passed, more fear spread among the creatures of the city. Until suddenly, a new notification appeared.
[Title Acquired]
[Nightmare of Monsters]

[Description: Monsters within a 10-meter radius become scared for 10 seconds, and their senses are weakened by 20 percent. This effect does not apply to monsters that are more than 10 levels above the user.]
Seeing the notification, Lian laughed. Who would have thought he would get such a title? And at that moment, the nearest monster jumped back in terror.
As if it had really seen something scary. Seris also received a similar notification.
She looked at the fleeing monster. The poor creature immediately fell to the ground and started crawling in fear.
"Interesting." Seris just said.
Seeing this situation, normal people might feel pity for the terrified monsters. But her? She just cut the monster’s neck.
By evening, more than thirty monsters had been killed. The streets of Frostheart were again colored red.
But this time, no creature dared to resist. A large number of monsters fled the city.
Some to the mountains, some to the frozen plains. Anywhere to get away from these two monsters that looked like humans.
When darkness ruled the city, the killing finally stopped.
He and Seris had returned to the corpse of the Fallen monster. The wind blew through their hair.
The city that had almost become their grave was now the grave of these monsters.
Lian was cutting the corpse of that Fallen monster into pieces so he could put it in his storage space. He had also collected the corpses of the other monsters he had killed.
So there was no way he would leave this one, which could be extremely valuable.
"Are we going back?" Seris broke the silence.
Lian stared into the distance for a few seconds, toward where they had come from and the path to the golden mountain. Then he gave a cold smile.
"Yes." His gaze darkened.
"It’s time to go back to that damned village."

The streets of Frostheart were again colored red.
But this time, no creature dared to resist.
A large number of monsters fled the city.
Some to the mountains, some to the frozen plains.
Anywhere to get away from these two monsters that looked like humans.
When darkness ruled the city, the killing finally stopped.
He and Seris had returned to the corpse of the Fallen monster.
The wind blew through their hair.
The city that had almost become their grave was now the grave of these monsters.
Lian was cutting the corpse of that Fallen monster into pieces so he could put it in his storage space.
He had also collected the corpses of the other monsters he had killed.
So there was no way he would leave this one, which could be extremely valuable.
"Are we going back?" Seris broke the silence.
Lian stared into the distance for a few seconds, toward where they had come from and the path to the golden mountain.
Then he gave a cold smile.
"Yes." His gaze darkened.
"It’s time to go back to that damned village."

chapters.title: Chapter 33: Returning To The Village
paragraphs: The cold mountain wind passed through the trees, making a sound like the moaning of ghosts.
It took them about three days to return to the village. That’s when they realized just how far they had gone from the village, and how fast Liyan had been running at that time
Lian and Seris finally stood on a high point overlooking the village. From here, almost the whole village could be seen.
Wooden houses, cold chimneys, and of course silence. An unnatural silence. No one could be seen in the village, even though it was morning.
So where were the village people?
"It is too quiet." Seris narrowed her eyes.
Lian stared at the village for a few moments.
"It is normal. From the outside, nothing is clear."
"Do you think all the villagers will attack us?" She asked.
"Probably yes... but I cannot be sure."
Seris ran her hand over the handle of the Frostfang sword.
"If all of them are as strong as Mira, the fight will be very hard."
Lian gave a dry smile.
"Let’s hope that is not the case." Then before entering the village, he looked at his panel.
[Strength: 120]
[Spirit: 5]
[Speed: 66]
[Mana: 50]
[Resistance: 55]
[Stat Points: 88]
After killing about 17 monsters in Frostheart, his Stat Points had gone from 27 to 88. He had not used them, but now before entering, he wanted to use some.
He thought for a moment, then added 18 points to Strength.
[Strength: 120 --> 138]
Then he added 20 points to Mana.
And finally, he added ten points to Resistance.
[Resistance: 55 --> 65]
[Stat Points: 40]
He decided to keep the remaining 40 for now, because he might be in a situation where he needed to use them for a specific stat.
Then both quietly went down the slope. Their goal was to enter secretly. But just when they were a few steps away from the forest around the village...
A female voice came from behind them.
"So you came back."
Both immediately turned around. Lian’s pupils contracted. Mira was standing right behind them.
Silent and without warning. Even Blood Hunt had not felt her presence.
His gaze fixed on the panel that appeared.
[Race: ???]
[Rank: ???]
[Level: 18]
Her race was still unknown, but at least he could see her level for the first time.
"I did not think you would come back." Mira gave a quiet smile.
"There is something here that we want." Lian said coldly.
Mira tilted her head a little.
"Now that you are back... to be forgiven for your sins, you must become sacrifices to the god."
"Do you think you can defeat us alone?"
Mira laughed. A quiet, cold laugh.
"I see you have become stronger..." Then her gaze went behind them.
"But I am not alone.
At that moment... dozens of presences. Around them, behind the trees, on the rooftops, behind the houses. Everywhere. They appeared.
His eyes narrowed. Multiple notifications appeared.
[Race: ???]
[Rank: ???]
[Level: 12]
[Race: ???]
[Rank: ???]
[Level: 10]
[Race: ???]
[Rank: ???]
[Level: 10]
Dozens of them, and all had surrounded them. But luckily, their levels were not even close to Mira’s, and dealing with them seemed easier.
"I will handle her." Seris drew her sword, her gaze fixed on Mira.
It was clear she had not forgotten the previous defeat.
Lian nodded.
"I will hold off the rest."
The next moment, both exploded into action. The sound of metal and clashing attacks screamed in the air.
Seris charged at Mira like a meteor. At the same time, Lian attacked the group of villagers.
[Steelhide] activated.
His skin became harder, his muscles swelled, and a hidden layer of steel covered his entire body.
[Glacial Reaper Claw] activated.
Ice claws formed on his hands. And then...
[Storm Tyrant Fang]
Blue lightning coiled around his arm.
BOOM!
The first fist exploded directly into the face of one of the guards. Blood and bones sprayed on the snow.
[Monster level 10 killed]
[3 stat points gained]
[Analyzing Target...]
[Analysis Complete]
[Race: Dreadmaw]
[Rank: Mutated]
For a moment, Lian frowned. Finally, the system had managed to identify this race. So he only needed to kill one of them.
And the rank Mutated? That is not among any of the five known ranks for monsters. Of course, that does not mean it is something strange.
Mutated ones are very rare and are considered unusual and anomalous. In terms of overall power, they are lower than Fallen monsters, but much higher than normal monsters.
But there was no time to think more. Three monsters attacked him at the same time. Lian rolled on the ground, passed through their strikes, and dragged his ice claw across the stomach of one of them.
A deep tear was made. Intestines spilled out. The creature screamed, and the second hit severed its neck.
System notifications appeared one after another.
[Dreadmaw level 9 killed]
[Dreadmaw level 9 killed]
[Dreadmaw level 10 killed]
But the enemies were not few. Attacks came from all sides. The whole village was attacking him, and dealing with them was not easy at all.
In the distance... Seris and Mira were tearing up the ground. Each collision created a wave of energy.
But Lian had no time to look. A level 12 monster attacked from behind. Its axe landed on Lian’s shoulder.
CRACK!
The armor cracked, and blood sprayed. But before the man had a chance to smile, Storm Tyrant Fang exploded.
Blue lightning went directly into his chest, and his whole body turned black as he fell to the ground.
[Dreadmaw level 9 killed]

The only problem was that these monsters looked completely like humans, and killing them seemed a little hard... at least not for Lian. After seeing that scene under the abandoned houses, he could not see these monsters as humans at all.
The enemies became fewer and fewer, but Lian’s wounds increased. Blood dripped from his arms. Even though he was stronger, these monsters were very many.
His breaths had become heavier, but he still fought. Always forward, always more savage, until only half of the enemies remained.
And that was the moment he decided to end it. Besides, it would be a good test to see that skill.
[Frozen Cataclysm]
The ground shook. The air around froze. The surrounding snow lifted into the air. Suddenly, a massive ice storm exploded.
Hundreds of ice blades shot up from the ground. Screams filled the sky. Blood sprayed on the white snow. Houses split open.
The ground froze. When the storm stopped, a large part of the battlefield had turned into a graveyard of ice.
Lian fell to one knee. He had used 30 mana instantly, but it was worth it.
His breaths were heavy, but a few still remained. At that moment, a shadow passed by him.
Seris, the Frostfang sword in her hand, blood dripping from dozens of wounds on her body.
"Rest a little."
And without waiting, she went toward the remaining monsters.
Lian pulled himself back, sat behind one of the broken houses, and at that moment, something caught his attention.
The torn corpse of one of the creatures. He frowned and went closer.
The creature’s chest was split open.
And there, a human heart was placed. Completely human, but around it, slimy, parasite-like organs could be seen.
Flesh that did not resemble human at all. Black veins. Twisted organs.
Lian’s eyes narrowed.
"So that is why they were removing hearts..." Now everything made sense. He was sure that these hearts were the reason for their mutated state.
But he was a little curious about what this mutation exactly was. Because in his view, these monsters were not that strong. Or maybe he had become too powerful?
But he did not think this mutation was exactly about their own power. Unfortunately, he had no information to reason with.
A few minutes later, the last scream also went silent. Seris returned. Bloody, tired, but alive.
Her gaze fell on the heart. She was silent.
"So those are the hearts of those humans." She then said.
Lian nodded.
"Yes."
Seris was quiet for a few seconds.
"Before I killed Mira, she said something." Then she said.
"What?" Lian raised his gaze.
"She said the twins and Ryan are alive."
"What?" Lian’s eyes widened.
"She said the village elder took them to the Mountain God to sacrifice them for the final mutation."
Final mutation? What the hell is the final mutation? He did not know what it was, but he felt a very bad feeling. His instinct was screaming that he should not let this final mutation happen.
Silence. A few seconds of absolute silence. Then Lian stood up.
"Then we should not waste time."
Finding the path was not hard. A path that went up through the mountain, a path that led straight to the golden peak. The same stone-paved path he had seen before.
Dozens of minutes later, they finally reached the entrance of a massive cave. The air around it was unnaturally cold.
Even for Lian, who should have cold immunity, could feel a bone-chilling cold.
Absolute darkness waved inside.
Both looked at each other, then entered. They had not taken more than a few steps when a system notification appeared.
[You Have Entered Monster Territory]
[Dreadmaw Sovereign]
[Rank: Unholy]
[Level: 20]
Is this the Mountain God?

chapters.title: Chapter 34: Are They Brainwashed...?
paragraphs: The cold of the cave crawled over their skin like an invisible blade.
Even Lian, who now, thanks to his talents and skills, had become almost resistant to normal cold, felt that the air around him had become heavier than before.
But what really made his spine freeze was not the cold.
It was the system notification.
[You Have Entered Monster Territory]
[Dreadmaw Sovereign]
[Rank: Unholy]
[Level: 20]
A heavy silence ruled between him and Seris. For a few seconds, neither said anything. Even the sound of their breathing was barely heard.
Seris’s face, which was always calm and emotionless, changed for the first time. Her eyebrows came together, her eyes opened a little wider, and then fear! Very little, but it was there.
Lian had never seen anything like that on her face before.
"We should retreat." Seris then said quietly, but worry was clear in her tone.
Lian did not answer immediately, because he had been thinking the same thing.
An Unholy.
A monster even higher than Fallen ones, and at level 20! Only one step away from its first evolution, and maybe even now its evolution process had started.
This was no longer a creature at their level. This was something beyond any monster they had seen so far.
Lian clenched his fist, his gaze fixed on the notification. They had no chance of defeating this one. He was sure of it, with no doubt.
Even though he had become much stronger than the last time they were in this village, he and Seris had barely won against a level 19 Fallen monster.
And an Unholy? Even thinking about it was stupid.
"If things get bad, we run." He then said quietly.
Seris looked at him.
"Run?" Seris looked at him as if she had heard a joke.
"If necessary, we just run. Don’t worry."
He still had stat points and could use all of them for speed if needed. He could also upgrade Fallen Wolf Speed if necessary.
Maybe they could not defeat an Unholy, but he was confident about escaping.
A few moments of silence passed.
"...Okay." Finally, Seris said quietly and looked into the depths of the cave.
"I trust you again."
The two continued moving. The further they went, the colder it became. The stone walls of the cave were completely buried under layers of ice.
The sound of their footsteps echoed in the dark space. Every few meters... bones. More bones appeared. Some belonged to humans, but most did not.
Massive skulls, ribs as big as an adult human body, and spines that looked terrifying even after turning into bones.
"This place looks like a predator’s den." Seris said quietly.
Lian said nothing, because he felt exactly the same. As if all the monsters that had entered this mountain... had died here in the end.
A few minutes later, they reached the center of the cave, and at that moment, both stopped. Two massive cocoons hung from the ceiling.
And on the other side, at the end of the cave, there was a huge stone door. Beyond that, there was no way forward.
White, slimy threads like spider webs covered the area around them. Inside both cocoons, shadows could be seen.
Human shadows.
"Could it be them?" Seris frowned.
"Maybe." Lian answered quietly.
A moment later, Seris lifted off the ground, and the Frostfang sword flashed in the air.
SLASH!
The connecting threads were cut. Both cocoons fell to the ground with a heavy sound, and the impact made the slimy liquid inside them shake.
And suddenly, a movement. Then a second movement. Lian’s eyes narrowed.
They were alive.
Seris delivered another strike, and the cocoon fabric tore. A thick liquid flowed onto the ground.
And three bodies fell out of it.
Aria.
Ryan.
And Alisa.
Ryan and Aria were inside one cocoon, holding each other’s hands. Alisa was in the second cocoon.
A moment later, all three started coughing, expelling the liquid from their lungs, and then they barely opened their eyes.
Lian stepped forward.
"Are you okay?"
But at that moment, Aria’s face lost its color, as if she had seen a ghost.
Ryan also froze.
Alisa started to tremble.
Suddenly, all three backed away in horror, as if an enemy was standing in front of them, not a rescuer.
Lian frowned.
"What’s wrong?" Lian frowned and could not understand the reason for their behavior.
"Stay away!" Aria shouted with a trembling voice.
"You are monsters!"
Lian and Seris both stopped. A few moments of silence passed.
Ryan threw himself in front of the two girls, and despite his legs shaking, despite his obvious fear, he still stood.
"I won’t let you hurt them!"
Lian was confused.
"What do you mean?" What was happening here? Did they look like ghosts that these three were so terrified?
"You thought we didn’t see?!" Aria’s eyes filled with tears.
"You killed all the village children!"
Lian completely froze.
"What? When did we do that?
"Don’t lie!" Tears fell down Aria’s face.
"We saw everything!" Images of that night appeared in front of her eyes.
Children.
Screams.
Blood.
Corpses.
And two monsters that were Lian and Seris.
Lian suddenly remembered something. The children. All those children. When he had fought the villagers, there were no children.
Not even one. They had completely disappeared. And now he realized that he had not seen any children in the village.
Of course, he was sure those children were actually monsters, not real humans. But regardless, they were not there.
"Brainwashed?" Seris whispered quietly.
Lian was thinking the same thing, and if not, what other answer could there be? But the question is, why would they brainwash these three?
He even thought that these three should have been dead by now, and that they are still alive is a surprise in itself to him.
He could not understand, what is this final mutation? Why are these three being kept for it? And why were they in these cocoons? What is this cocoon?
But before he could answer, a sound echoed in the cave.
Grrrrrrrrrrrr...
All four turned toward the sound. At the end of the cave, the massive stone door began to open.
The ground shook. A golden light shone from the crack in the door. And then the sound of footsteps was heard.
Tak.
Tak.
Then a familiar voice was heard.
"Is the ceremony finally over?"
Lian’s eyes suddenly narrowed. He knew this voice. Very well.
The light moved aside, and a man came out from behind the door. A calm smile was on his face. The same usual smile, the same friendly smile.
The village chief!
He glanced at the torn cocoons, then his gaze slid over Aria and the others, and finally fixed on Lian and Seris.
His smile deepened.
"Oh? So you two came back."
At that moment, a new notification appeared in front of Lian’s eyes.
[Dreadmaw]
[Rank: Mutated]
[Level: 20]
He glanced briefly at the notification. Fortunately, they were not facing a Fallen one; the monster in front of them was a level 20 Mutated.
The village chief smiled, looking at them for a long time.
"It’s good that you came back, because with you, the ceremony will go better." He then said quietly.
